name: Offer Countdown Timer for WooCommerce
author: QueueCommerce

sections.description: Offer Countdown Timer – Create Urgency and Boost Sales with Beautiful Live Countdown Timers! Display real-time countdowns for flash sales, limited-time offers, and seasonal promotions.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

Go to WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New

Search for “Offer Countdown Timer for WooCommerce”

Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Go to any WooCommerce product and set your countdown timer

Manual Installation

Download the plugin zip file

Go to WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New

Click “Upload Plugin” and choose the zip file

Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Configure the countdown timer in product settings
sections.faq:
How do I set up a countdown timer?

Edit any WooCommerce product, find the “Offer Countdown Time” meta box, set your end date and time, then update the product.

Can I use multiple timers on different products?

Yes! Each product can have its own unique countdown timer with different end dates.

What happens when the timer reaches zero?

The countdown banner automatically hides itself and disappears from the product page.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Absolutely! The countdown timer is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WooCommerce-supported classic theme.

Can I customize the appearance?

Currently, the plugin uses beautifully designed modern gradient banners. Future updates may include customization options.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is translation ready and includes .pot file for translators.

What timezone does the countdown use?

The countdown uses your WordPress site’s timezone setting (Settings > General > Timezone).

Does it work with variable products?

Yes, the countdown timer works with all WooCommerce product types.

Can I use this for product launch countdowns?

Absolutely! Perfect for building anticipation for upcoming product launches.
